integrity: All distribution and robustness identities are supported by the explicit spherical chamber proof. The checker is finite corroboration only; literature comparison is provisional and not a proof of historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Regular tetrahedral four-vertex code on the Euclidean unit two-sphere; one uniform query direction; no general code, correlated-query noise, or finite-sample inference theorem. Possible equivalent classical spherical inner-parallel formulae have not been completely ruled out.
title: Exact margin and robustness laws for the tetrahedral spherical Voronoi partition
